name: SparseOIT Rasterizer
aliases: GPU software rasterization of 3D Gaussians with pre-rendering
definition: A rasterization algorithm for 3D Gaussians that computes a weighted blended order-independent transparency (OIT) image and a pre-rendered image simultaneously, using a blend-and-normalize (BAN) function and a blend-and-update (BAU) function. The sorting step only orders entries by tile ID, and the blending process is independent of the depth order of the Gaussians.
summary: SparseOIT Rasterizer renders 3D Gaussian Splatting using Order-Independent Transparency without depth sorting, replacing standard accumulation with a weighted average via Blend-and-Normalize and Blend-and-Update functions.
